# AI-Tadpole-OS

> A local-first, sovereign multi-agent runtime designed for high-performance orchestration, private memory, and human-in-the-loop governance. Version 1.1.464 (Plane 1 GA).

AI-Tadpole-OS (Tadpole OS) separates directives, orchestration, and execution into a robust, three-layer architecture to solve the probabilistic reliability issue of LLM applications.

## Key Technical Specifications (v1.1.464)
- **Core Runtime**: Local Axum 0.7 + Tokio asynchronous Rust execution engine for deterministic thread/process isolation and sub-millisecond telemetry.
- **Dual-Plane Architecture**: Plane 1 (Sovereign Codebase Lifecycle Engine, GA) for self-maintaining codebases; Plane 2 (Company-Agnostic SMB Digital Twin, Developer Sandbox & Scenario Preview) with fail-closed tenant workspace isolation.
- **Agent Orchestration**: Hierarchical coordination of 62+ registered agent nodes via topologically scheduled DAG execution (Kahn's / DFS dependency sorting) with a 10Hz MessagePack telemetry heartbeat.
- **Agent Intelligence & Self-Annealing**: Agent 99 autonomous post-mission wisdom extraction continuously writing lessons back to institutional memory (`LONG_TERM_MEMORY.md`).
- **Private Memory & Vector RAG**: Embedded LanceDB vector store (768-dimensional IVF-PQ embeddings), SQLite transactional dual-write atomicity, and Open Knowledge Format (OKF) data contracts.
- **Codebase Knowledge Graph**: Tree-sitter AST symbol graph indexing 7,205 symbols and 43,517 dependency edges with interactive BFS Dependency Pathfinder.
- **A2A Economic Zone**: Service-to-service payment protocol using Two-Phase Commit (2PC) locks, daily budget caps, and x402 challenge handshakes.
- **Safety & Zero-Trust Governance**: Sapphire Shield capability gates intercept high-consequence operations (budget spending, shell execution, filesystem mutation) behind human operator approval and tamper-evident SHA-256 Merkle audit chains.
- **Active Documentation Guard (ADG v2)**: Continuous invariant testing preventing documentation drift across human prose, machine witness manifests (`adg.manifest.json`), and executable test invariants (`tests/invariants/`).

Performance, security, and regulatory outcomes depend on deployment configuration, infrastructure, models, and operating procedures. References to ISO 9001, ISO 42001, NIST AI-RMF, ALCOA+, or GxP describe design mappings or intended control support; they are not certifications.
